# Bangkok Pattaya Bus Guide

> Independent guide to bus travel between Bangkok and Pattaya, Thailand: timetables, fares in THB, station guides and practical boarding tips. The guide also covers private transfers and vans as alternatives when a bus is not the best fit. Every schedule page names its source and shows a "last checked" date. Canonical content is English under /en/; translations exist under /th/, /zh/, /ru/, /de/, /fr/ and /pl/.

## Routes (current timetables, fares and boarding details)

- [Bangkok to Pattaya bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/bangkok-to-pattaya): departures from Ekkamai and Mo Chit 2 terminals
- [Pattaya to Bangkok bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-bangkok): return direction with Ekkamai and Mo Chit arrivals
- [Suvarnabhumi Airport to Pattaya bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/suvarnabhumi-airport-to-pattaya): direct airport bus, boarding at Level 1 Gate 8
- [Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-suvarnabhumi-airport): boards at North Pattaya Bus Station; a separate service connects Suvarnabhumi and Jomtien
- [Don Mueang Airport to Pattaya bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/don-mueang-airport-to-pattaya): airport bus with an interval-based schedule
- [Pattaya to Don Mueang Airport bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-don-mueang-airport): fixed daily departures from Pattaya Bus Terminal

## Station and planning guides

- [Ekkamai Bus Terminal to Pattaya](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/ekkamai-bus-terminal-to-pattaya-guide): BTS access, ticket counters, boarding
- [Mo Chit Bus Terminal to Pattaya](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/mo-chit-bus-terminal-to-pattaya): Mo Chit 2 vs Ekkamai comparison
- [Jomtien Bus Station (Thappraya Road)](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/jomtien-bus-station): airport bus boarding point on the Jomtien side
- [Hotels near Pattaya Bus Station](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/hotels-near-pattaya-bus-station): where to stay for bus-based trips
- [Pattaya Bus Station to Jomtien](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-bus-station-to-jomtien): onward travel after arrival
- [Suvarnabhumi Airport Gate 8 bus](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/suvarnabhumi-airport-gate-8-pattaya-bus): where to find the Pattaya bus at the airport
- [Bangkok to Pattaya bus vs taxi](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/bangkok-to-pattaya-bus-vs-taxi): cost and comfort comparison
- [Bangkok to Pattaya after midnight](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/bangkok-to-pattaya-after-midnight): late-night options
- [Pattaya to Bangkok before a flight](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-bangkok-before-flight): time-buffer planning
- [Don Mueang Airport to Pattaya bus guide](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/don-mueang-airport-to-pattaya-bus): arrival-terminal guidance, direct-bus planning and transfer alternatives
- [Pattaya to Don Mueang Airport bus guide](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-don-mueang-airport-bus): boarding-point guidance, flight buffers and direct-service planning
- [Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport before a flight](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-suvarnabhumi-airport-before-flight): North Pattaya boarding, airport arrival and flight-buffer planning
- [Pattaya to Bangkok: which terminal?](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-bangkok-which-terminal): choosing Ekkamai or Mo Chit for your Bangkok destination
- [Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi: North Pattaya or Jomtien?](https://www.bangkokpattayabus.com/en/pattaya-to-suvarnabhumi-which-station): compare boarding stations and choose the airport service that fits your location
